decisive_spans.text: Scrotal ultrasonography demonstrated a solid, well-demarcated, hyperechoic, hypoperfused 1.3 × 1.1 cm mass at the tail of the right epididymis

response.rationale: The patient presents with a mass localized to the epididymis, and imaging confirms an epididymal mass. D4 (Epididymal tumor) is a direct match. D3 (Spermatocele) is a cystic lesion, but the imaging describes a 'solid' mass, which contradicts D3.
